title: A characterization of IE-closed subcategories via $τ$-tilting theory
summary: Enomoto and Sakai classified functorially finite IE-closed subcategories over hereditary algebras in terms of twin rigid modules. Their approach uses the hereditary assumption essentially and therefore does not extend directly to arbitrary finite-dimensional algebras. In this paper, we introduce canonical twin support $τ$-tilting modules and prove that, for an arbitrary finite-dimensional algebra, they are in bijection with left-and-right finite IE-closed subcategories, namely those whose generated torsion and torsion-free classes are both functorially finite.
